result.summary: Identified minor visual and layout inconsistencies across category filters, truncation, and redundant badges.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' filter is active, but non-pizza food items are displayed in the feed.
issues.suggestion: Update listings to match the active filter or remove the active state on default view.

issues.description: Third carousel card label is truncated awkwardly at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Adjust card width or text wrapping in the horizontal scroll container.

issues.description: Duplicate delivery fee information shown in both the image badge and subtitle metadata.
issues.suggestion: Remove the redundant subtitle mention when a badge is present.
